cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Admit What You Wanted
cards.instruction: Maneuver them into revealing which outcome they truly wanted before you explain your own stake.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Which job offer did you secretly want me to accept? Please.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Before you knew which one made me happy.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Because I haven't told you what I chose, and this is our last unbiased minute.
